manual_recipe: Open https://www.addgene.org/127546/sequences/ in a logged-out desktop browser, expand 'Addgene-Verified Full Sequences (1)' (sequence object 251803) or 'Depositor Full Sequences (1)' (244230), and use that section's GenBank / SnapGene download button. The URLs the page's own API advertises (/api/get-sequence-file-collection/<id>/ -> genbankUrl, snapgeneUrl) return HTTP 404 to curl, to curl with a browser user-agent, to curl with a Referer from the sequences page and to curl with that page's cookie jar, while every sibling viewer artifact in the same directory returns 200; plasmid 12259 behaves identically, so the refusal is Addgene's, not this plasmid's. Deposit the downloaded .gbk beside these files and re-run with --genbank <path> to replace the reconstruction.
